lemmas.primary_translation: to smile or laugh to oneself

definitions.text: smile eller le for seg selv
definitions.translation: to smile or laugh to oneself (lit. smile or laugh into one's beard)

examples.no: leseren lo i skjegget av den tørre vitsen
examples.en: the reader laughed quietly to himself at the dry joke

examples.no: jeg måtte smile litt i skjegget av kommentaren
examples.en: I had to smile a little to myself at the comment
